--COPY DATA

CREATE TABLE copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(20),
    Units_Sold INT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
) 

SELECT * FROM copy_into_table;

--LOAD DATA

COPY INTO copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID,
    Model_ID,
    Branch_ID,
    Date_ID,
    Units_Sold,
    Revenue
)
FROM 'https://extsynapsestorage.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/cetas_revenue/'

WITH
(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (
        IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'
    )
);

SELECT * FROM copy_into_table
